item.title: Platform Overview
item.description:
KubeSphere Enterprise employs a fine-grained access control mechanism. Depending on the role of the logged-in user, the KubeSphere Enterprise web console is displayed differently. This section introduces the modules and functionalities of the KubeSphere Enterprise web console from the perspective of a user with the platform-admin role.
Module Functionality Top Navigation Bar The top navigation bar displays entries for clusters and workspaces by default.
